chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Nothing weighs more on the Scale than good character.

key_terms.الميزان: The Scale of Deeds on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the heaviest thing on the Scale of Judgment according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to emphasize that moral excellence (husn al-khuluq) outweighs all other deeds in the Hereafter, a concept central to Shia ethical theology. This tradition underscores the practical manifestation of faith, aligning with the Imams' teachings that good character is the heaviest burden on the Scale of Judgment. It serves as a reminder that inner piety must be reflected in outward conduct to achieve spiritual weightiness.
